(d) `an open laptop` — lowest risk; if it fails, thicken the screen panel and widen the base wedge's perspective so the silhouette is unmistakably a laptop and not a book. THE RULE FROM RUN 15 BINDS: after TWO failed cold reads on the same object, stop refining the drawing, build two candidates (the best refinement plus a different metaphor carrying the same meaning), read one namer per candidate, and render only the one that reads.
